title: DeepMind's PR 93 engine on two more starts of its table: no halt in 10<sup>1350</sup> steps
text: 1RB0LC_1RC1RA_1RD0RF_0LE---_1LA1LE_0RA0RF and 1RB0RF_0LC---_1LD1LC_1RE0LA_1RA1RD_0RD0RF are the table of busycoq pull request 93 with its halt turned into a step and a D0 detour, started in states B and D. For each, a Coq proof of halting built from that file compiles with one assumption, that its accelerated engine stops. The engines ran 18.7 and 15.0 million fast steps without stopping, on tapes of more than 2<sup>4486</sup> cells.
